cases.title: CDDESIGN opens the Design window on its Start tab, says how many of six things are set, and closes without writing anything
cases.plan_item: CDDESIGN draft (triage group D1; engineering-judgement items stay with Tim)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with triage group D1 only (start of the route: window, tabs, count of things set). No design number and no D1 bug text is proved.
cases.expected: CDDESIGN prints "[CE] <n> of 6 things this design needs are set." (n is 2 in a freshly started AutoCAD and 1 in a reopened copy of the same drawing: both runs on 3.0.73 showed it, and the case does not pin n); the window shows five tabs (Start, Setup, Areas and route, Results, During), the line 'Start with the job and its sources. Save a draft when you are ready.' and 'Land use not set.'; closing it leaves no CE window and the drawing file unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The count of set items and the window come from the real drawing's job data.
not_automated: THE DESIGN NUMBERS ARE NOT DRIVEN: orifice head kept, outlet kept, grade printed, own rainfall and C used (BUG-259, BUG-506, BUG-508 to BUG-511, BUG-515, BUG-1004) need the Setup, Areas and Results tabs filled and engineering values judged by Tim. Only the start of the route is checked.
